title: How do you access, update, and destructure JavaScript object properties?
expectedConcepts: Dot notation vs Bracket notation for dynamic keys
Object destructuring syntax with default values
hints: When the property name is stored in a variable, can you use dot notation?
Destructuring lets you pull out properties in one line: const { prop } = obj.

codingExercise.instruction: Write a function getFullName(user) that destructures firstName and lastName from the user object and returns a formatted string "firstName lastName".
